title: Lekalo Storage Rename History
description: Closed independent contract for the validated storage rename history of one base-to-candidate transition (issue #57). The document carries the owner-reviewed physical renames: which table or column changed its stored name and where the evidence comes from. Renaming a Model symbol never renames a table; a physical rename exists only when this document declares it. The planner applies it only after validating the map against its two pinned attachments - the old name exists in the base, the new name is unoccupied in the candidate, entries are one-per-source and one-per-target, and the project and both digests match exactly. Without validated evidence a same-entity name change stays a destructive drop+add pair. The document is pure data - no credentials, hosts, URLs, users, wall-clock timestamps, or provider output.

projectId.description: The stable project identity both pinned attachments belong to.

baseDigest.description: The canonical digest of the base storage-projection attachment; must equal the pin exactly.

candidateDigest.description: The canonical digest of the candidate storage-projection attachment; must equal the pin exactly.

renames.description: The declared physical renames in canonical byte-sorted order.

storageName.description: One physical storage name under the shared snake_case grammar.

entity.description: The stable entity key both names belong to.

kind.description: The closed rename target: a table (or join table), or a column of one table.

from.description: The physical name in the base projection; must exist there under the same entity.

to.description: The physical name in the candidate projection; must be occupied by the renamed object there.

historyRef.description: The semantic-history reference the review cites: a stable symbol id, a registry entry, or a reviewed ticket.
